summary: A multi branch Abu Dhabi dental group appears to lose bookings to zero counters, popup only booking and inconsistent details.

findings.problem: The counters for Years Collective Experience, Dedicated Dental Professionals and Customers Served appear to read 0.
findings.cost: Zeros wipe out your strongest proof.

findings.problem: Our Branches appears to link to #, and Book An appointment and Watch VIDEO appear to rely on popups.
findings.cost: Visitors hit dead ends if a popup fails.
findings.fix: A working branch page and plain booking links.

findings.problem: The booking form appears to end at 2:00 PM to 8:00 PM while branches are listed open until 9:00 PM and 10:00 PM, and the form appears not to confirm a booking.
findings.cost: Patients may think they are booked, or miss late slots.
findings.fix: A real booking form with all open hours and confirmation.

findings.problem: Typos such as Restorative Denistry and Madinat Al Ryad appear, the page appears to say Based on 730 reviews but show about four, and one review appears empty.
findings.cost: Typos and thin proof weaken trust.
